race.title: Conway Piling Beginners Chase
race.verdict: After only the 2 outings over hurdles, MIGHTY PARK looks an exciting prospect for chasing and starts off in a race in which Willie Mullins tends to introduce one of his better novices, Gaelic Warrior landing the prize in 2023. He gets the vote ahead of stablemate Saint Baco , with Fierce Handay and Powerful others to consider. MIGHTY PARK (IRE) SAINT BACO (FR) FIERCE HANDAY (IRE)
